meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 能检索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:按关键词、项目、日期、类型找出过往会话的摘要(ID、时间、标题),再按需取前后时间线与完整详情,只有摘要不够时才去读原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是之前会话而非当前对话时触发,例如「这个我们解决过吗」「上次怎么做的」「上周发生了什么」等。

say.text: 搜一下之前和登录认证有关的会话记录
say.note: 返回带 ID、时间、标题的索引表

say.text: 上周迁移失败那次是怎么处理的?
say.note: 按关键词和日期范围搜索并给摘要

say.text: 把 #11131 前后的上下文拉出来看看
say.note: 返回该记录前后的时间线条目

howto.what_en: Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory by keyword, project, date, or type, returning summarized records with IDs, times, and titles, then pulling timelines and full observation details, and reading raw tool I/O only when summaries are not enough.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about earlier sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we fix this already?", "how did we do X last time?", or "what happened last week?"

say_en.text: Search past sessions about login authentication
say_en.note: Returns an index table of IDs, times, titles

say_en.text: How did we handle that migration failure last week?
say_en.note: Searches by keyword and date, then summarizes
Returns entries before and after the anchor
